Name: Bleed
Effect: Take 1 damage per tile moved; each point of damage removes a stack.

Name: Stun
Effect: Cannot take any actions: no cards, no movement.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Giant Beaver 'Chomp' (3t); Cerberus 'Venom Tail' (15t, also knocks 3 cards from hand); Inflamed Minotaur 'Bull Rush' (5t, chance = spaces x4%); self: Stone Encase [Strap of Stone] (5t), Cryonics (15t on the iced ally or self)

Sources: Pipe Crawler 'Claw' (25% chance, 5t); self: Shield of Growth (10t), Succumb phase 2 (10t)

Name: Burn

Sources: Fire Goblin Mage 'Ember' (1); Fire Mage 'Fire Bolt' (2); Inflamed Minotaur 'Attack' (2); Ifrit 'Fire Breath' 5x5 (5); fire tiles stepped on: Fire Goblin Shaman 'Fire Wall' (3), Ifrit breath tiles (5), Minotaur wake and Bull Rush lane (2, heals him 10); self: Wand of the Phoenix Feather backlash (1 per burn-applying play)

Name: Poison

Expiry Model: Value decays 1 per cycle; also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: White Manticore 'Stinger' (8)

Name: Cursed
Effect: Deal 20% less damage and take 20% of the damage you deal as self-damage.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: None in the live game (exists only in the player/enemy mirror maps used by Expel Negativity)

Name: Frozen
Effect: Cannot play cards (movement still allowed).
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Automatic when Cold reaches 5 stacks (in practice the Ice Troll)

Name: Cuffed
Effect: Cannot draw cards.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Cerberus Venom Tail aftermath when the stun ends (10t); self: Succumb (10t)

Name: Shocked
Effect: Arc X damage to nearby allies at the start of each cycle, then lose 1 stack.
Expiry Model: Value decays 1 per cycle; also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: Spark Mage 'Spark' (1 stack, 15t)

Name: Slowed

Expiry Model: Stacks (never expires by the clock) or Timed (tempo)

Sources: Ice Mage 'Frost Bolt' (1); Spiked Web trap in cave interiors (2, plus 5 damage); self: Petey the Pet Rock while in hand (held at 2), Approach (timed, 10t)

Name: Weighted

Name: Global debuff riders
Effect: Laced Arrow (Stephen) adds +1 Burn/Cold/Shock; Wither (Cory) adds +1 to any debuff; Territorial Death re-applies an existing one; Expel Negativity moves one of your debuffs onto the nearest enemy; Misery Loves Company spreads the highest values on an AoE; Feral Evocation swaps burn/cold/shock/poison to the slot's element.
Sphere Grid Amp: Stun / Bleed / Burn / Shock / Slow / Root / Disarm / Silence / Vuln / Weaken Amp nodes strengthen debuffs but never apply one
Sources: Laced Arrow, Wither, Territorial Death, Expel Negativity, Misery Loves Company, Feral Evocation
Notes: Reference row: these touch any debuff, so they are not repeated per effect.
